text_block_list.text:
The racing Racewear sent out for 
alterations has arrived. Cesario tries it 
on right away to check if everything is in 
order.
choice_data_list: How is it? Feeling any strain anywhere?
How does it feel? Anything too tight?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Conditions are good. I swung my arms and 
legs with full range of motion, and there 
was no catch or discomfort anywhere.

Cesario answers with even more resolve 
than usual. Her conviction is enough to 
overwhelm the person who asked—
choice_data_list: Dressed in that outfit, you're truly "on."
Dressed in that outfit, you're truly "on."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. When I am wearing my racing outfit, I 
am a warrior.

A true warrior—no words fit her better. 
Capable of overcoming any hardship— that 
is the commanding aura Cesario holds right 
now.

Perhaps it was due to the feelings poured 
into the racewear. The first time I caught 
a glimpse of those feelings was right 
before submitting her racewear design—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? The design submission deadline is 
that soon!?
choice_data_list:
I see. Apparently there was a mix-up, 
which is why the notice was delayed.

Yeah. Apparently there was a mix-up, which 
is why the notice was delayed.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, what a mess...! But don't worry. 
I've actually already come up with a 
design for my Racewear!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It's this one here... Do you think it'll 
work?

What Cesario showed was an undeniably 
clumsy drawing, like one done by a small 
child. However, because there was no real 
issue with the design—
choice_data_list:
Sounds good. Let's make a clean copy and 
submit it.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! Thank you very much! Hehe♪

Although we met the submission deadline, 
we hadn't talked about the design of the 
racing silks since. Thinking this was a 
good opportunity, I decided to ask right 
here.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Truth be told, I designed that back when 
I was a child, based on the costume of a 
heroine from a comedy play I saw at the 
time."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Due to certain circumstances, the heroine 
is separated from her family, and in order 
to survive on her own, she disguises 
herself as a man to serve a duke, but—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
While keeping her fluttering maiden heart 
tightly hidden, she fulfills the mission 
given to her as a man.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Her dignified, noble figure overlapped 
with the legendary Tiara Umamusume as they 
answered the press interviews."
choice_data_list:
That's who you aspire to be—to serve as 
the foundation.

That is who you aspire to be—to serve as 
the foundation.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
There must have been immense hardship 
before seizing the Tiara. Yet they never 
let it show, demonstrating their resolve 
to fight head-on.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I want to become a cool Umamusume like 
that too." ...I remember wishing that with 
all my heart as a child.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I wanted to incorporate the 
cross-dressing attire worn by the heroine 
into the design.
choice_data_list: So that's what makes you a "fighter," huh?

text_block_list.text:
No wonder Cesario becomes so focused when 
wearing her racing silks. While 
understanding that, what's been on my mind 
since earlier is...
choice_data_list:
Could this be the comedy you were talking 
about?

text_block_list.text:
From the shelf where hobby books were 
kept, I pulled out a play script. The 
moment Cesario saw the title, her face lit 
up with joy.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
This, this is the one! Huh, you like it 
too, Trainer...?
choice_data_list: Yeah. It's one of my favorite books
Yeah. It's one of my favorite books.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Waah, what a surprise! We're matching, 
aren't we♪

I knew she liked comedies, but to think we 
had the same favorite play. Discovering an 
unexpected common bond, we both smile.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Having it as a book gives it a whole new 
feel! Hehe, it's such a lovely read. The 
wording is just so beautiful!"

Cesario flips through the pages of the 
book with delight.

Then, pausing on a page, she pointed to a 
line spoken by the heroine.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Yet, I know all too well. Just how 
profound the love a woman holds for a man 
can truly be—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"This is a line where the heroine, in love 
with the duke, uses a metaphor to convey 
her feelings."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
If only she could just reveal her true 
identity— and yet, she continues to play 
her part.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Sheathed the sword, saluted, altered my 
gait and gestures, flawlessly, beyond any 
shadow of a doubt.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I, too, wish to be strong like that. For 
the road to becoming a 'cornerstone' will 
surely be a steep and arduous one."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"This racing attire sharply switches me 
'on.' That is why I can fight, forge 
ahead, and overcome any obstacle."

My heart begins to pound furiously. The 
same thrill I felt when I first saw her at 
the debut race was shaking my very soul.

I was captivated by the grand vision she 
held. I was utterly mesmerized by her 
dignified presence.

Wanting to support her, fulfill her 
dreams, and walk the same path. A new 
desire to 'fight alongside her' joined 
them, making my heart burn with passion—
choice_data_list:
Let's make sure to show you have the 
capacity to be that "cornerstone".

Let's take it one race at a time, 
steadily.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. With strength worthy of this outfit, 
I will prove that I have the caliber to be 
a 'cornerstone.'"

Making her powerful declaration, Cesario 
radiated so much majesty that it felt like 
she could swallow the entire stage whole.

I must sublimate this radiance into a 
guiding beacon for the Umamusume of the 
future— With my heart pounding, I made a 
firm resolve.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I understand. Great achievements are built 
on small steps. I shall carve hoofprints 
worthy of this racing silk.

Making her powerful declaration, Cesario 
was so dignified that she utterly 
captivated everyone watching.

I must sublimate all the praise I've 
gathered into a solid path that future 
Umamusume can walk— Feeling the weight of 
responsibility, I made a firm resolution.
